Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AQ Pup: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2991.1 +/- 141.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2991.1 +/- 141.3 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2751 +/- 0.0226 mas (same row, RUWE 1.18), 12.2 standard errors, is not used. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 137.2 +/- 6.6 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AQ Pup: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 137.2 +/- 6.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 95,450,040 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5125 +/- 208 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 20, Name='AQ Pup', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5125 +/- 208 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
